fusions.name: Coiled Lunge
fusions.desc: Uncoils at a target up to 4 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spat Venom
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lie in Wait
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Measured Doses
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
